title: Create an account
description: Five details are enough. You will complete your profile afterwards.

fields.emailHint: It will be your sign-in name and will receive the verification link. Your work address is preferable.
fields.countryHint: The country you are taking part from.
fields.passwordHint: At least eight characters, with one capital and one lowercase letter.

legal.text: By creating an account, you accept the platform's {terms} and {privacy}.

nextStep: Linking your organization is the next step: it comes after your address is verified, and can be resumed at any time from your profile.
